about_the_game:
Decorate, care for and protect Andalusian patios in this relaxed strategy game with a lot of heart.

🪴 Water the plants by solving chain water droplet mini-games. The better you do, the prettier your plant will look.

🎨 Decorate your yard with painted plates, stamps, flower pots, sentimental objects and many more surprises.

🧩 Solve environmental puzzles to improve every corner and unlock new areas.

🐦 Explore unique courtyards full of life, secrets and characters with stories to discover.

👵 Talk to your grandmother Julia and other endearing characters who will guide you and make you laugh... or despair.

A quiet game with sparkle

Each patio is a small world that reflects the culture and soul of Andalusia. From humble patios to more stately ones, your mission will be to take care of them with love, creativity and strategy. Ideal for those looking for something beautiful, relaxed and with touches of humor and social criticism.

🎮 Compatible with keyboard, mouse and gamepad.

🌍 Available in Spanish.

👷 Demo in development.

🎨 Colorful artistic style, inspired by Andalusian folklore and popular aesthetics.

short_description: Enter the world of Teo, a young girl who returns to her neighborhood to help her grandmother Julia prepare for the traditional courtyard contest. What seemed like a quiet job of watering and decorating soon becomes complicated with mysterious real estate plots and neighbors with a lot to tell.
